IIT Bombay Mid-Semester Exams Postponed Amid Death Investigation

IIT Bombay has postponed its mid-semester examinations following the death of student Sahil Wakode. As part of the ongoing investigation, 20 people have been questioned. Sahil's family has begun a hunger strike. A significant challenge for the crime branch is unlocking Sahil Wakode's iPhone, which is protected by a pattern lock. Current forensic tools are reportedly unable to extract data from newer models, and police hope unlocking the phone will reveal details about the events leading up to and following his death on September 18.
